entities.summary: Latif-ur Rehman, also known as Latifur Rehman, was a field hockey player who competed internationally for India and Pakistan. He won a gold medal as a member of India's team at the 1948 Summer Olympics and a silver medal playing for Pakistan at the 1956 Summer Olympics. The 1956 silver was Pakistan's first ever Olympic medal.
